derivedEvidence.debian: installed binary packages from /var/lib/dpkg/status and status.d records in the final virtual filesystem
derivedEvidence.node: regular /usr/local/bin/node plus NODE_MAJOR_VERSION, NODE_MINOR_VERSION, and NODE_PATCH_VERSION macros from /usr/local/include/node/node_version.h; binary is never executed

serialization: strict canonical JSON with lexicographically sorted object keys and package arrays
limitations: Independent package-inventory derivation only. It is not a vulnerability scanner, does not execute or mount the image, and does not establish that the image is safe. Unsupported formats fail closed.
